title: Absolute and relative Kummer generator arrows
statement: For a commutative ring $A$ killed by $m$, a scheme $T$ on which $m$ is invertible, and a unit $w$, let $x_w:A_T[0]\to L_T[1]$ be the normalized derived Kummer class of [def-pur-normalized-kummer-cohomology-arrows]. Define $A\to H^1(T,L_T)$ by applying $H^0$ to its global realization $A[0]\to R\Gamma(T,L_T)[1]$ and the canonical single and shift comparisons. For $p:B\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and the punctured-line family of [def-pur-normalized-kummer-global-arrows], define its relative generator as the actual Leray edge section $A_B\to R^1a_{B,*}L_{C_B}$ of $x_t$, using the canonical edge construction of [def-pur-kummer-exchange-class-arrows]. Here $t$ is the Laurent coordinate unit of [def-pur-kummer-line-geometry], pulled back to the family. Define the relative punctured inclusion by the pullback map induced by $k[t]\to k[t,t^{-1}]$ and the identities of $B$ and $\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Its bounded-below generator is the same map transported by the inverse of the canonical compatibility $R^+\Gamma\mathbin{;}\iota\cong\iota\mathbin{;}R\Gamma$; this is a specified comparison, not a new class. The over-base equality used by the relative inclusion is [lem-pur-kummer-line-inclusion-over].
